subject: Iteration 14: rotoscoped hand from the source video (hand IoU 0.95-0.96)
changelog: vs v13: 2 source file(s) changed, +89/-14 lines (render.js, scenes.js).
- scripts/trace-hand.js: per-frame hand silhouettes from the user's source video
(warm/cream skin threshold, largest component, hole fill, soft edges) written to
ref/derived/hand/ (gitignored derived media; regenerate with the script)
- hand scene renders thermal shading inside the traced mask each frame (motion comes
from the trace); drawn hand remains as fallback for untraceable frames
- masks are preloaded asynchronously (image decode is async in @napi-rs/canvas);
render.js awaits preload in workers and stills mode
- traced-hand colours tuned against measured region colours of the source
